container.title: Readable Tests
config.title: Readable Tests
config.extraArgs: VSTest: extra arguments passed to `dotnet test --no-build`.
config.projectExclude: Glob pattern excluded when looking for test projects. wwwroot and dist folders are excluded by default: they hold copied libraries (with their own package.json), not test projects.
config.revealFailures: Expand failed tests in the tree after a run.
config.mtp.extraArgs: MTP: arguments passed to the test application (e.g. ["--timeout", "5m"]).
config.xunit3.extraArgs: xUnit v3 (native command line): arguments passed to the test application (e.g. ["-parallel", "none"]).
config.targetFramework: Target framework for multi-targeted projects (e.g. net9.0). Empty = first declared.
config.inlineErrors: Show a failure summary at the end of the assertion line in the editor.
config.build: When to build before running tests.
config.parallelProjects: Run several test projects in parallel (disable if projects share a resource: database, port…).
config.runner.xunit3: Always xUnit v3 native command line (direct run)
config.build.auto: Build only if a file changed since the last successful build
description: Readable test results for .NET and JavaScript: TUnit / Microsoft.Testing.Platform, xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Vitest, Jest, Angular CLI. Expected/actual diff, code excerpt, clean stack traces, inline errors, fast runs.
capabilities.untrusted: Runs dotnet build and the test binaries from this workspace: only enabled in trusted workspaces.
config.nodePath: Path to the node executable used to run Vitest, Jest and the Angular CLI.
config.vitest.extraArgs: Vitest: extra arguments passed to `vitest run`.
config.angular.extraArgs: Angular CLI: extra arguments passed to `ng test` (e.g. ["--browsers=chromiumHeadless"]).
